label: Country
definition: FAOSTAT reporting-area label retained for the selected country
allowed_values: Botswana; Eswatini; Lesotho; Malawi; Mozambique; Namibia; South Africa; Zambia; Zimbabwe

label: Calendar year
definition: Calendar year of the FAOSTAT maize observations

label: Maize yield
definition: Reported maize yield converted to tonnes per hectare
missing_values: blank represents missing or unavailable yield
source: FAOSTAT QCL Yield value in kg/ha

label: Maize production
missing_values: blank represents missing or unavailable production
source: FAOSTAT QCL Production value in t
transformation: Reshape the Production element from rows to a column

label: Maize harvested area
definition: Reported annual area harvested for maize
missing_values: blank represents missing or unavailable area
source: FAOSTAT QCL Area harvested value in ha
transformation: Reshape the Area harvested element from rows to a column

label: Log maize yield
definition: Natural logarithm of positive maize yield in tonnes per hectare
missing_values: blank when yield is missing or non-positive
transformation: Apply the natural logarithm only to positive yield
